mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in the past month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in the past three months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% in the past three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% in the past month signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increased by more than 1% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% in the past two months signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 0.5% in the past two months.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on mechanism where a high federal funds rate (above 4%) signals a restrictive monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% in the past three months coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 signals a tightening labor market with strong job growth, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 3 months and PAYEMS increases > 100,000
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% and PAYEMS increased by more than 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% in the past month signals a broad-based strengthening of demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increased by more than 1% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional mechanism where an increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% in the past quarter signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during an economic expansion regime.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 increased by more than 2% during an economic expansion.
